title: Learn the CHARLESTON Step-by-Step | Authentic 1920s Jazz Dance

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains steps clearly with enthusiasm and provides multiple variations. She uses counting and verbal rhythm to guide students through posture and footwork.

lesson_structure.note: Welcoming students and introducing the Charleston steps.
Demonstrating the pattern of the basic Charleston step from the back.
Practicing the basic step while moving forward.
Introducing Charleston Kicks with swing style.
Teaching Charleston with Twist, focusing on the heels.
Teaching Twist on the ground variation.

metaphors: Imagine that you're dancing on a hot frying pan
common_mistakes: Leaning upper body backward instead of keeping continuous body position to the front

steps_taught.name: Basic Charleston step
steps_taught.description: Step back and touch with bounce and opposite arm movement.

steps_taught.name: Charleston Kicks
steps_taught.description: Swinging kicks replacing steps with wider, groovier movement.

steps_taught.name: Kick Step
steps_taught.description: Holding and kicking then stepping where you kicked.

steps_taught.name: Charleston with Twist
steps_taught.description: Twisting on heels with the weight on balls of feet.

what_works: Demonstrating from behind helps mirror footwork easily
Clear verbal cues matched to rhythm
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between multiple variations without much repetition

quotes.text: What makes it swing is the groove and the bounce.
Make sure that the body position is continuously to the front.
Extremely important already on that stage to focus on your opposition.
Imagine that you're dancing on a hot frying pan.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates basic Charleston footwork facing away from the camera, counting 5-6-7-8 while stepping back and touching.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on the floor

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher moves forward toward the camera demonstrating arm swing and body lean during the step.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact muscular tension in the arms

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates back and front kicks with heel shakes from a rear angle.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact height of the kick relative to hip level

evidence_segments.observation: Close-up of the teacher's red shoes showing heel twists and weight shifting to balls of feet.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: foot pressure distribution inside the shoe

extraction.distinctive_method: Categorizing Charleston variations into distinct stylistic eras like '20s style', 'Savoy swing style', and 'Afro twist' to explain posture and movement quality differences.
